items.title: Dihybrid cross aur independent assortment (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the dihybrid cross (PDF 86-88).

blocks.text: F1 paudon ka genotype jaanchne ke liye Mendel ne unhein khud-fertilize kar ke F2 nasl banayi. 3:1 ke bajaye F2 mein chaar phenotypes aaye: gol peele, gol hare, jhurridar peele aur jhurridar hare, 9:3:3:1 nisbat mein.

blocks.alt: RrYy x RrYy ka 4 x 4 Punnett square, dono taraf gametes RY, Ry, rY aur ry. Har 16 khanon mein genotype aur aik chhota beej hai jo gol ya jhurridar, peela ya hara hai, aur khana phenotype ke rang mein hai. Saath ki key ginti karti hai: 9 gol peele, 3 gol hare, 3 jhurridar peele aur 1 jhurridar hara.
blocks.caption: Mendel ke dihybrid cross ka F2 (Figure 18.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gol peele RRYY ko jhurridar hare rryy se milane par F1 mein gol peele RrYy dihybrids bante hain. Kyunke alleles ka har jora alag alag (independently) juda hota hai, har F1 paudha chaar qisam ke gametes (RY, Ry, rY, ry) barabar tadaad mein banata hai, aur fertilization par 4 x 4 = 16 barabar imkaan wale milap bante hain: 9 gol peele (R_Y_), 3 gol hare (R_yy), 3 jhurridar peele (rrY_) aur 1 jhurridar hara (rryy). Alag alag ginein to gol aur jhurridar ab bhi 12:4 = 3:1 aur peela aur hara bhi 3:1 hai.

blocks.text: F1 dihybrid (RrYy) mein beej ki shakal ke alleles R aur r aur rang ke Y aur y hain. Gametes bante waqt chaar milap bante hain: RY, Ry, rY aur ry. Jab yeh milte hain (4 nar x 4 maada gametes) to F2 mein 16 milap bante hain: 9 gol peele, 3 gol hare, 3 jhurridar peele aur 1 jhurridar hara.

blocks.title: Law of independent assortment
blocks.text: Nataij ne dikhaya ke beej ki shakal ke genes beej ke rang ke genes se azadana alag hote hain. Mendel ne kaha ke 'gametes bante waqt alleles ka har jora doosre joron se azadana alag hota hai'.

blocks.title: Maloomat aur dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Mukhtalif genes ka azadana alag hona har allele jore ki segregation par asar nahi karta, is liye gol aur jhurridar ab bhi 3:1 aur peela aur hara bhi 3:1 dikhate hain. Qanoon ka jadeed bayan yeh hai ke 'mukhtalif chromosomes par maujood genes meiosis mein azadana alag hote hain'.

Independent assortment sperm aur egg bante waqt alleles ko mila deti hai aur genetic tanawwu (diversity) paida karti hai: mukhtalif chromosomes par mukhtalif khasiyaton ke alleles azadana alag hote hain, is liye aik khasiyat, jaise aankh ka rang, doosri, jaise baalon ki banawat, par asar nahi karti.

Yeh is liye hota hai ke meiosis mein homologous chromosome jore ittefaqan qatar banate hain, jis se gametes mein maa aur baap ke alleles ke mukhtalif milap bante hain. Insan mein is se aik gamete ke 8 million se zyada (2 ki power 23) milap ban sakte hain, is liye har gamete genetically munfarid (unique) hai. Fertilization mazeed tanawwu laati hai kyunke do munfarid gametes mil kar munfarid zygote banate hain; yeh milawat species ko badalte mahol mein dhalne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: RrYy x RrYy ke F2 mein 16 mein se kitne gol aur kitne hare hain?
blocks.explanation: Gol: 9 + 3 = 16 mein 12 (3/4). Hare: 3 + 1 = 16 mein 4 (1/4). Har jora akela ab bhi 3:1 deta hai.

items: F1 RrYy RY, Ry, rY, ry banata; F2 9:3:3:1.
Gamete bante waqt har allele jora doosron se azadana alag hota hai.
Meiosis mein homologues ki ittefaqi qatar: insan mein 8 million se zyada (2^23) gamete milap.
